home.title: Math Kingdom
home.subtitle: Where numbers come alive and math is magical
home.footer1: Every adventure teaches real mathematical ideas through play and wonder.
home.footer2: Pick an open adventure to begin your journey.

infinity.title: Hilbert's Amazing Hotel
infinity.description: Visit the hotel that always has room for one more guest — even when it is completely full. Discover infinity with a parade of animal guests and one very determined unicorn.

primes.title: The Prime Number Orchestra
primes.description: Conduct an orchestra where instruments only play on prime numbers. Find the mysterious rhythm of 2, 3, 5, 7, 11… and turn it into music.

fractal.title: The Fractal Pizza Palace
fractal.description: Slice a pizza that contains endless copies of itself. Zoom into a world where the same pattern repeats forever, at every size.

probability.title: The Probability Carnival
probability.description: Join friendly monsters at carnival games. Predict outcomes, spin wheels, and learn why some things are more likely to happen than others.

fibonacci.title: The Fibonacci Bunny Garden
fibonacci.description: Watch rabbits multiply in nature's most beautiful pattern, and find the golden spiral hiding in flowers, shells, and galaxies.

topology.title: Topology Space Adventure
topology.description: Travel with alien friends who bend and stretch shapes without breaking them. Watch a coffee cup turn into a donut and learn what "the same shape" really means.

graphs.title: Graph Theory Kingdom
graphs.description: Help knights and dragons travel between castles. Solve the famous bridge puzzle and learn how mathematicians map connections.

mystery.title: The Secret Math Mystery
mystery.description: A surprise adventure awaits explorers who finish every other quest. What mathematical magic hides in the final challenge?

hotel.title: Hilbert's Amazing Hotel
hotel.subtitle: The hotel that always has room for more

dialogue.single: “Excuse me — do you have a room available?”
dialogue.bus: “We're a tour group of five! Do you have five rooms?”
dialogue.infinite: “We're infinitely many buses with infinitely many guests. Can you fit us all?”

hotel.finished: You solved every mystery of Hilbert's Hotel! Even when something is completely full, sometimes you can still add more. That is the magic of infinity. ✨

single.1: 🦄 **One new guest!** Our hotel has infinitely many rooms, and every single one is taken — room 1, room 2, room 3, all the way to infinity! Then a new guest arrives. Press **Start the story** to see what happens.
single.2: A unicorn wants a room, but every room is occupied! How can we fit one more guest when infinitely many rooms are full? The hotel manager has a brilliant idea. Press **Show the magic!** 🪄
single.3: ✨ **The magic happens!** Every guest moves to the next room up: room 1 → 2, room 2 → 3, room 3 → 4, and so on forever. Nobody falls off the end — there is always a next room! And look: room 1 is now free. 🏠
single.4: 🎉 **It worked!** The unicorn gets room 1, and everyone else still has a room. That is something amazing about infinity: even when infinitely many rooms are full, there can still be space for one more.
single.5: 🎓 **You did it!** You discovered that infinity + 1 = infinity. Mathematicians use this idea to understand infinite sets. Ready for a bigger challenge? Try **A bus full of guests**! 🚌

bus.1: 🚌 **The bus challenge!** Now for something harder. A whole bus with five guests arrives at our completely full hotel. Five new rooms, when every room is taken? Sounds impossible… or is it? Press **Start the story**.
bus.2: A tour bus pulls up with five guests who all need rooms — but every room from 1 to infinity is occupied! The manager smiles: this time the plan is even cleverer. Press **Show the magic!** ⭐
bus.3: 🎯 **Double magic!** Every guest moves to the room with double their number: room 1 → 2, room 2 → 4, room 3 → 6. Now all the odd-numbered rooms — 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, … — are empty. That is infinitely many free rooms!
bus.4: 🌟 **Incredible!** The five passengers settle into the freed odd rooms 1, 3, 5, 7 and 9, and every old guest still has a room. One clever move made space for the whole bus — and there is still room for infinitely more!
bus.5: 🧠 **Genius level!** Infinity + 5 = infinity too — and doubling actually made infinitely many free rooms. Ready for the ultimate challenge? Try **Infinite buses**! 🚌♾️

infinite.1: ♾️ **The ultimate challenge!** Here comes the wildest scenario of all: infinitely many buses arrive, and each bus carries infinitely many guests. Surely that cannot fit! Press **Start the story** for the greatest magic trick.
infinite.2: Infinite buses with infinite guests — that is infinity × infinity new arrivals! Even mathematicians once thought this was impossible. But our manager knows a secret. Press **Show the magic!** 🎭
infinite.3: 🔮 **Prime number magic!** The manager sends every current guest to a prime-numbered room: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, … Then each new guest gets a room from a special formula built from their bus number and seat number — and no two guests ever collide! 📐
infinite.4: 🌟 **Mind = blown!** Every single guest — all infinity × infinity of them — gets a room of their own. Prime numbers made the impossible possible!
infinite.5: 🏆 **Mathematics master!** You discovered one of the deepest secrets in mathematics: some infinities can be matched up perfectly, and Hilbert's Hotel can welcome them all. 🎓✨
